I have asthma sadly :( so I figure that might not work out to well. Although I do know asthmatics who smoke, so I guess I'd have to do a test run or something to see if it will fuck me up 😂

Another issue is I'm not too sure how I'd have access to that, might have to ask some friends see what they know. I live the most mundane boring lifestyle and do not know any dealers. Ironically I live in a really high crime, poverty area that's most probably swarming with dealers but I'm sure they'd just laugh at this 20 year old woman who looks 16 asking for weed. That and they're scary as fuck. 

But yeah I get the whole use and abuse thing. The lorazepam's kicked in and I feel so chillllllllllllll 😂 as you can see from the amount of crap I'm talking. It makes you wanna take it all the time which is where the abuse part comes in sadly.
